name: garland pose malasana
description: A deep squat with elbows pressing the knees apart and palms together. It stretches the hips, groin and ankles.
instructions: Stand with feet slightly wider than hips and toes turned out.
Lower into a deep squat, keeping your heels down if you can.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Press your elbows against your inner knees and lengthen your spine.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
